name: 300 Nen Buri no Chikyuu ni, Nake
source:
In 2030, World War III breaks out. By spring 2031, Russia declares war on Japan. Japan joins the Allies in the conflict, but things quickly spiral out of control. The war finally ends in 2035 after America launches nuclear missiles.

The result? Earth becomes unlivable due to radiation. Humanity finds hope in a new planet called Tellus.

In 2060, humans finish moving to Tellus. But how did humanity manage to relocate so quickly—just 25 years after the war ended? It's a taboo topic on Tellus.

Fast forward to 2359. Ren Ariwara is an orphan living at "Koropokkur Kotan." He's obsessed with Earth and hated by everyone around him. Recently on Tellus, more and more "Earth fanatics" like Ren have appeared—people who idealize Earth's past and technology.

One day, Ren is falsely accused of hacking into a British-area server and sentenced to exile back to Earth—a punishment set for one year later. Secretly wishing they'd just execute him instead, Ren soon learns he's not alone: seven other high-school students were also sentenced to exile.

Meanwhile on Tellus—a planet that's become as rotten as a filthy public toilet—strange things are happening: protests, coups, Earth-return movements... and eventually World War IV.

As their exile approaches, Ren and the others grapple with questions: Why exile to Earth? Who framed them? Who are they really? How will humanity survive from now on? Which planet—Earth or Tellus—is their true home?

Everything will be decided by war.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/9043]freem[/url]]
translation:
2030年，第三次世界大战爆发。到2031年春天，俄罗斯向日本宣战。日本加入盟军参战，但局势很快失去控制。2035年，美国发射核导弹，战争终于结束。

结果呢？地球因辐射而不再适合居住。人类将希望寄托于一颗名为Tellus的新行星。

2060年，人类完成向Tellus的迁徙。但人类为何能在战争结束仅25年后如此迅速地迁往新星球？在Tellus上，这是个禁忌话题。

时间来到2359年。Ren Ariwara是“Koro Pokkur Kotan”的孤儿。他痴迷于地球，因此遭到周围人的厌恶。最近，Tellus上出现越来越多像Ren这样的“地球迷”——他们理想化地看待地球的过去与科技。

某天，Ren被诬陷入侵英国区服务器，被判处一年后流放回地球。他暗自希望人们干脆处死他，却很快发现自己并不孤单：还有7名高中生同样被判流放。

与此同时，在这个已经腐败得像肮脏公共厕所一样的Tellus上，怪事不断发生：抗议、政变、重返地球运动……最后甚至爆发了第四次世界大战。

随着流放日逼近，Ren等人不断追问：为什么要流放到地球？是谁陷害了他们？他们究竟是谁？人类今后如何生存？地球与Tellus，哪一个才是他们真正的家园？

一切都将由战争决定。
